notes.title: Patch Notes V0.0.6
notes.content:
-Fixed a bug when some enemies couldn't move even after the end of paralysis

-Survival optimization

-Changed the original appearance of some interiors

-Added the ability to change the wallpaper in the player's house

-Added sounds for purchasing items and interacting with some items

-Fixed a collision in different locations

-Added a new location near the village

-Updated rain particles

-Added an indication of the name of the item in the description of items

-Fixed the description of one of the daily quests

-Added a new daily quest

-Most spells in survival now attack closest enemies

notes.title: Patch Note v0.0.5
notes.content:
-Chest now closes itself when player walking

-The distance between buttons in the help and quest menus has been increased

-Fixed the sharp animation at the end of the mini-game at Alphonse

-Fixed the name and description of the daily quest from Shin

-Fixed the spawning of enemies outside the arena

-The name of "Rare Dust" is now displayed correctly

-Reduced the attack radius of skeleton mages

-Penalty for completing the same levels in tower has been reduced

-Number of enemies that bats can penetrate has been reduced

-Fixed the sharp shaking of the camera when moving

-The skill book has been reworked, in addition, it will now also contain information about items and crafting

-The item description menu has been removed and moved to the book

-Now items can be dropped by dragging them to an empty space on the screen or dropping an item in the quick slots using the button (can be changed in settings)

-Added bind for quest menu

-Increased furnace and chest price

-Full Spanish language support

-Fixed some animations

-Fixed a bug where walking sound could work incorrectly depending on FPS

-Added help, skill, crafting and quest buttons to the inventory menu

-New dialogues for some NPCs

-Increased chances of getting items in the arena

-Added a new character and mode that you can try by talking to the new character
Here you can use various magic spells, even those that you haven't unlocked yet.
For each level you complete, you will receive a reward for the first completion, as well as unique passive buffs
The experience you receive in this mode is reduced

-Fixed the problem with obtaining one of the achievements

-Now boars in the dark forest spawn correctly

-Increased boar damage

-Fixed a bug with the huge speed of some spells at high FPS

-Minor graphic changes

This update is aimed at making the game more understandable, as well as to diversify the game in the early stages

notes.title: Patch notes v0.0.3
notes.content:
-Translation of two spells

-Fixed incorrect collision in the village

-Quest, notification, help and active quest windows have been changed

-Improved translation: fixed some mistakes in all languages, added translation of items that were not translated

-Added 2 achievements: reach 20, 30 levels of magic

-Added new character "Tom"

-Added Spanish language support(86%)

-Added a new mini game

-Fixed a bug when health could be recovered after death

-Fixed an issue with objects saving

-Smooth transition after starting a new game/continue

-Added better tips when starting a new game and in pop-up notifications

-Increased experience gained for the quest "New Beginning... Again"

-Slightly changed the main location

-Increased the cooldown of the spell "Water bullet"(3s->4s)

-Fixed various UI bugs

-Added background in sound and video settings to improve visibility of buttons and text

-Added the feature to get back in menu using ESC key

-Fixed a bug with double music playback after returning to the menu

-Smoother transition from the main menu after starting a new game/continue


Thank you for your interest in the game :)

notes.title: Patch notes 0.0.2
notes.content:
-The game no longer freezes when switching music for the first time
-Music no longer stops after a while until it finishes playing
-Added a translation that one of the spells did not have

Thank you all for your interest in the game :)
